notes: Read the source file line by line before editing and ported every exported devtools, system, repair, backup, export/import, API key, audit, and chatbot API function.
Source is non-visual API/type code; the native output uses React Native-safe request/apiUrl helpers and imports no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components.
Preserved endpoint paths, snake_case query parameters, request methods, JSON body shapes, response type shapes, and SI field names; window.open was replaced with Linking.openURL.

Browser File upload was replaced with a native-safe ImportUploadFile type supporting Blob or React Native {uri,name,type} values, and multipart upload bypasses the JSON default header so FormData remains valid.
